whatIs.title: What is the CS Fundamentals Quiz?
whatIs.description: A problem-solving learning tool covering 10 core computer science areas: Data Structures, Algorithms, Network, Operating Systems, Database, Computer Architecture, Software Engineering, Security, Linux/System, and Web Basics. 250 total questions (25 per category) with 3 difficulty levels: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Select a category (Data Structures/Algorithms/Network/OS/DB and more, 10 in total)
Each answer immediately shows the correct answer and explanation
After completing all questions, view your score, grade, and wrong answer review

tips.title: Study Tips
items: Start with Beginner to build a solid foundation
Carefully read explanations in the wrong answer review for better learning
Repeat the same category to identify and fix weak points
Focus on Intermediate and Advanced for interview preparation
Time yourself to build real-world test-taking skills

items.a: Yes, questions are shuffled randomly each time even with the same category and difficulty.
Yes, Intermediate and Advanced questions cover concepts frequently asked in technical interviews.

items.q: Can I retry only wrong answers?
items.a: Yes, use the 'Retry Wrong Only' button on the results screen to retry only the questions you got wrong.
